mistake: No component has the id root

errors.message: Missing root component: No component has id='root'

fix: Give one component of the surface the id `root`.

mistake: A child is written inside its parent's children

errors.message: Validation failed for component 'Column' (root): children.0: Expected string, received object; children: Expected object, received array

fix: Name each child by its id in `children` or `child`, and write the child as a component of its own in `components`.

mistake: A Button's child is written inside it

errors.message: Validation failed for component 'Button' (root): child: Expected string, received object

fix: Name each child by its id in `children` or `child`, and write the child as a component of its own in `components`.

mistake: A component is not in Quay's catalog

errors.message: Unknown component type 'Heading' not found in catalog 'urn:quay:a2ui:catalog:v1'. The catalog's components are Button, Card, CheckBox, ChoicePicker, Column, DateTimeInput, Divider, FileLink, Icon, Image, List, Progress, Row, Slider, Stat, Steps, Tabs, Text, TextField.

fix: Set `component` to one of the components of Quay's catalog that the error lists.

mistake: A property is not on the component's line

fix: Give each component only the properties on its line in quay_surface_guide, each of the type the line gives: where it says string, 3 is "3".
